name: Takechi Hanpeita
source:
"We can't entrust Japan to the Shogunate any longer."
A member of the Tosa clan that is loyal to the emperor and [url=/c43441]Okada Izou's[/url] master.
He's looked after Izou for a while now. 
He's known for his honest character, but there is a mysterious side to him.
